summary: Russia launched a massive drone barrage against Kyiv and other Ukrainian regions, employing 277 strike drones including 155 jet-powered variants, hitting residential areas, schools, and infrastructure. Russian forces reportedly captured Ulanovo in Sumy region and Novovodyanoye in Donetsk region while advancing near Bilytskyi. Ukrainian officials claim 10,660 Russian casualties over the past week on the Lyman axis.

sections.executive_summary: Russia conducted its largest drone attack of the war overnight, launching 277 strike drones including 155 jet-powered Shaheds against Kyiv and multiple Ukrainian regions, damaging schools, kindergartens, residential buildings, and diplomatic facilities. Russian forces simultaneously claimed territorial gains in Sumy and Donetsk regions while advancing near Bilytskyi, as Ukrainian officials reported 10,660 Russian casualties on the Lyman axis over the past week. The EU failed to reach agreement on supplying Patriot missiles from national stockpiles, while Poland conditioned licensed Patriot production on US approval.

sections.threat_assessment: The unprecedented scale of jet-powered drone deployment (155 of 277 total) signals Russian escalation in long-range strike capabilities, specifically targeting civilian infrastructure in Kyiv including educational facilities and diplomatic missions. Simultaneous territorial claims in Sumy and Donetsk suggest coordinated pressure on northern and eastern fronts. The failure of EU Patriot consensus and conditional Polish production offer indicate persistent Western air defense supply constraints. Russian Geran-5 missile penetration to central Kyiv demonstrates evolving penetration tactics against Ukrainian air defenses.
sections.regional_response: Poland's proposal to host Patriot production for Ukraine remains contingent on US licensing approval, reflecting NATO supply chain dependencies. Lithuania added Usmanov and Friedman to national sanctions list citing security threats. German intelligence reportedly intensified surveillance of Russian embassy in Berlin with demonstrative helicopter flights. EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas confirmed no new decisions on Patriot transfers after Brussels meeting, highlighting alliance fragmentation on air defense commitments.
sections.intelligence_notes: The jet-powered Shahed variant's dual role as strike platform, MESH relay, and real-time reconnaissance asset (filming Inkom strike from 3km) represents significant tactical evolution. Geran-5 missile trajectories from Chernihiv/Sumy toward Kyiv indicate established northern launch corridors. Ukrainian disclosure of 107.4 billion hryvnias for Fire Point drone production reveals substantial domestic investment in unmanned systems. Russian casualty claims of 10,660 on Lyman axis in one week, if accurate, suggest unsustainable attrition rates for offensive operations.
